rationale: All three lenses ran and no blocking defect survived triage: the CodeMie-id to native-id resolution, the agent-agnostic rewrite in AgentCLI, and the owned/external handling all match the plan and are test-covered. Confidence is medium because the Jira ticket text was not available locally (acceptance was audited against the plan's derived criteria; AC 6 and AC 7c verified, other ticket ACs not seen) and neither the integration test nor the full unit gate was executed in this review (the QA report shows 12 unrelated environment failures). Triage: 1 defer (native-id match is not filtered by agent name; same as the old scanSessionsForClaudeId behavior) and about 20 dismissed as speculative, below-floor or accepted design (e.g. owned record with no usable native id passes the CodeMie id through unchanged per plan assumption 4; full-directory scan on resume; stat/rename race; mtime ties; non-string field in self-written records).

business_review.item: Goal: --resume <codemie-session-id> resolves the CodeMie id to the native Claude id and passes it to claude -r
business_review.notes: resolveClaudeResumeSession + ClaudePlugin.nativeResumeId + AgentCLI rewrite of options.resume and CODEMIE_RESUME_SESSION_ID; covered by AgentCLI-resume tests.

business_review.item: Goal: the run stays CodeMie-owned (no external-resume origin, no prompt/audit-block)
business_review.notes: Resolved id returns owned:true; test asserts no prompt, no audit, no external-resume origin.

business_review.item: AC 6: non-interactive resume of a resolved CodeMie id is not blocked
business_review.notes: Owned result never reaches shouldBlockNonInteractiveResume. End-to-end integration test is written but was not executed (needs SSO/JWT).

business_review.item: AC 7c: unknown id returns owned:false with no nativeId (existing external-resume flow kept)
business_review.notes: Resolver and plugin tests cover it; the gate is unchanged for owned:false.

business_review.item: Constraint: AgentCLI and core/types.ts stay agent-agnostic; new ResumeOwnershipResult field optional
business_review.notes: Optional nativeResumeId with a generic doc comment; no agent-name conditionals in shared code.

business_review.item: Constraint: resume ids are format-agnostic, only control characters stripped
business_review.notes: /\p{Cc}/gu only; covered by a control-character test.
readdir/parse/stat wrapped in try/catch; non-object JSON skipped with tests.

business_review.item: Constraint: code style and real-temp-dir tests
business_review.notes: No any/console.log in the diff, explicit return types on exports, real temp dirs used.

business_review.item: Review Focus 1: <uuid>-<generation> id resolves to that generation's native id
business_review.notes: Exact displayed-id match ranks first; tests cover gen_a/gen_b.

business_review.item: Review Focus 2: bare CodeMie UUID with several generations resolves to the newest file's native id
business_review.notes: Acceptance lens rated this partial: commit bda3aebc added a tier so a generation with a usable native id beats a newer one without (locked in by a test), while the plan still says 'newest'. Orchestrator judged the criterion's intent (deterministic, not arbitrary; newest wins among usable records) met and the refinement safer than passing a CodeMie id to claude -r. Review Focus is reviewer guidance, not a required AC. The plan text is stale and the owner may want to confirm the ranking.

business_review.item: Review Focus 3: missing/'unknown'/self-equal agentSessionId is owned but not rewritten
business_review.notes: usableNativeId returns undefined; it.each test and gate test cover it.

business_review.item: Review Focus 4: CodeMie id of a non-Claude agent is not resolved
business_review.notes: codemieMatches filtered by CLAUDE_AGENT_NAMES; native-id match is unfiltered, as before (deferred).

business_review.item: Review Focus 5: native id wins over a CodeMie-id match; control chars stripped; audit keeps both ids
business_review.notes: Covered by 'prefers a native-id match' test and plugin auditData.

business_review.item: Task 1: resolver shape, scanSessionsForClaudeId kept as wrapper, marker/metrics files ignored
business_review.notes: Matches the plan; no other callers of scanSessionsForClaudeId exist in src.

business_review.item: Task 2: ClaudePlugin.resolveResumeOwnership reports nativeResumeId, fallback command and auditData
business_review.notes: Matches the plan; test file name differs cosmetically.

business_review.item: Task 3: gate rewrites only the --resume option, not the positional path, and logs both ids
business_review.notes: Guarded by options.resume; ClaudePlugin does not implement extractNativeResumeId, so the positional path does not apply to it.

business_review.item: Task 4: docs/COMMANDS.md updated to say --resume accepts a CodeMie or native id
Task 4: integration test resumes by CodeMie id and asserts exit 0, no 'not created through CodeMie', native linkage
business_review.notes: Acceptance lens rated this partial: the test asserts secondRecord.resumeSessionId === first native id (a real Session field populated from the rewritten CODEMIE_RESUME_SESSION_ID) plus origin !== external-resume, instead of the plan's correlation.agentSessionId check. Orchestrator judged this a valid, arguably stronger equivalent. The test was not executed here.

standards_review.notes: Commit f9efe1fb has the subject 'epmcdme-17189-resume-codemie-session-id: add planning artifacts', which fails commitlint (type-empty, subject-empty). The other two commits and the PR title are conformant. Not treated as blocking: the repo squash-merges (the PR title becomes the commit message) and CI has no commitlint step. Reword it before merge if the history is kept.
ESM .js imports, no any, explicit return types on exports, logger.debug/info instead of console.log.

No secrets or credentials touched; ids are not sensitive; file access is limited to readdir/read of the CodeMie sessions dir with join(dir, name) from directory entries; control characters stripped before env/argv use.
